<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$evaluate-skill-change</code></p>

Compare a baseline and candidate skill on synthetic routing and behavior cases. Use only when explicitly invoked with $evaluate-skill-change; do not edit, install, or automatically adopt the candidate.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change --scope user
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Examples

### Gate a proposed skill rewrite

**Prompt**

> Use $evaluate-skill-change with this baseline, candidate, and case file. Tell me whether the candidate should be adopted.

**Expected outcome**

An accept, reject, or needs-review decision based on identical cases, held-out coverage, validation, and regressions.

### Check a trigger change

**Prompt**

> Use $evaluate-skill-change to compare these skill descriptions for routing precision without installing either candidate.

**Expected outcome**

Comparable routing and behavior evidence with the live skill left untouched and no automatic adoption.
